mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_keyword_match_target ( match_job_id, application_id, matched_keyword, match_score, notify_email_yn, notify_sms_yn, notify_status, sent_at, fail_reason ) VALUES ( #{matchJobId}, #{applicationId}, #{matchedKeyword}, #{matchScore}, #{notifyEmailYn}, #{notifySmsYn}, #{notifyStatus}, #{sentAt}, #{failReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT target.id, target.match_job_id, target.application_id, target.matched_keyword, target.match_score, target.notify_email_yn, target.notify_sms_yn, target.notify_status, target.sent_at, target.fail_reason, target.created_at, application.document_srl, application.applicant_name, application.application_status, application.email_address_enc, application.email_address_masked, application.mobile_phone_enc, application.mobile_phone_masked, CONCAT('Job #', application.document_srl) AS job_title FROM admin_keyword_match_target target INNER JOIN admin_job_application application ON application.id = target.application_id WHERE target.match_job_id = #{matchJobId} ORDER BY target.match_score DESC, target.id DESC

SELECT id, match_job_id, application_id, matched_keyword, match_score, notify_email_yn, notify_sms_yn, notify_status, sent_at, fail_reason, created_at FROM admin_keyword_match_target WHERE match_job_id = #{matchJobId} ORDER BY match_score DESC, id DESC
